scope: Manual corrections and event-level exceptions for historical ward legal linkage

14/2008/NĐ-CP@2008-07-02.review_note: The NSO legal index mislabels Resolution 14/2008/QH12 as a Government decree and shifts its 2008-07-01 effective date to the following SOAP observation date. The canonical resolution is retained separately.

14/2008/NĐ-CP@2008-08-03.review_note: The second NSO row repeats the same malformed instrument at the next SOAP observation date. It is not a second legal act and is superseded by the canonical Resolution 14/2008/QH12 record.

soap:2004-01-01->2004-07-01.review_note: The 21,287-component delta is the NSO old-to-national ward code-scheme transition. It is not a mass legal dissolution and creation event. The eight crosswalk omissions are retained as explicit source exceptions.

soap:2008-07-02->2008-08-03.review_note: The SOAP boundary combines the delayed Tân Đức transfer under Resolution 14 with the Hà Tây/Hà Nội boundary changes under Resolution 15. Two stale ward rows disappear at the same boundary and are classified as source cleanup, not legal lineage.
